description: Seam audit of the V6 seam fixes: V6_KEEP_DEPARTED (keep a departed migrant visible to the sender for the rest of its step) and V6_GHOST_LAYERS (ghost thickness in voxel columns), K=2 (all cases) and K=4 (2-D only), against the SAME V5 K=1 reference as matrix_v5_baseline.json - pass the same --out to reuse its reference dumps (the reference run ids do not depend on the matrix file).
window_note: two-pass crossing-capture window before the listed horizons (frames stepped one at a time): test runs capture every particle within 1.5 h of a seam-line crossing; --build-capture-requests unions them; the K=1 references then capture exactly those (frame, id) rows. Order: --roles test for every matrix sharing --out, --build-capture-requests, --roles reference, then --analyze-only.
note_3d: 3-D cavity3d_1m removed on 2026-10-02 at the user's request (2-D first); re-add {"name": "cavity3d_1m", "path": "cases/cavity3d_1m/case.yaml", "dimension": 3, "window": 200} to run it.
